info.title: Task Management API
info.description: A professional RESTful API for managing projects and tasks with authentication, authorization, and notification features. Built with Laravel 13.

post.description: Create a new user account and receive an authentication token. No authentication required.
Authenticate user with email and password, returns authentication token. No authentication required.
Revoke the current user's authentication token. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive dashboard statistics including project counts, task counts by status and priority, and overdue tasks for the authenticated user.
Retrieve a paginated list of all projects owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new project owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieve all available project status options with their labels and colors.
Retrieve details of a specific project. User must own the project.

put.description: Update an existing project. User must own the project.

delete.description: Soft delete a project and all its associated tasks. User must own the project.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of tasks for a specific project with optional filtering by status, priority, and search.

post.description: Create a new task within a specific project. User must own the project.

get.description: Retrieve all available task priority options with their labels and colors.
Retrieve all available task status options with their labels and colors.
Retrieve details of a specific task. User must own the parent project.

put.description: Update an existing task. User must own the parent project.

delete.description: Soft delete a task. User must own the parent project.

tasks_count.description: Total number of tasks in project
